name: Hiyayakko
description: A block of chilled silken tofu with ginger, spring onion and soy poured over.

tcm.note: Tofu is cool and moistening; served cold, in summer.

ayurveda.note: Shita — one of the coolest dishes in the set.

histamine.note: The tofu is nearly nothing; the soy and bonito on top are what rate it.
